notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Added two new maps[/h2]

[h3]Level 27[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924779/6b48127e709443420a57fa02702b71701f22e2a4.gif[/img]
To access other areas of the map, you need to use the lever to activate/deactivate the energy brigde.

[h3]Level 28[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924779/12893ff799aaf05929233724708ab9cb7072ea2a.gif[/img]
Walk between areas while avoiding the meteors.

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Lights not turning off when power goes out.
[*]No power icon not replicating to the client.
[/list]

tags.bug: - Lights not turning off when power goes out.
- No power icon not replicating to the client.
